name: The Spirit Of Witchcraft
overview: Scripture sternly condemns the spirit of witchcraft, forbidding any association with witches, wizards, or those who consult familiar spirits, as seen in commands like 'Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live' (Exodus 22:18) and warnings against seeking after wizards (Leviticus 19:31). The Lord declares severe consequences for those who turn to such practices, including being cut off from their people or even death (Leviticus 20:6, 20:27). God's people are instructed to avoid adopting the abominable customs of surrounding nations (Deuteronomy 18:9) and to seek the living God rather than the dead or occult sources for guidance (Isaiah 8:19). This teaching underscores the holiness and exclusivity required in the believer’s relationship with God, rejecting all forms of occultism as defiling and dangerous.
